run_retrieval_evaluation: run retrieval evaluation on ground truth responses and model scores from JSON files
evaluate_response_retrieval: evaluate response retrieval metrics including R1, R5, R10, mean rank, and MRR from candidate scores
run_single_round_retrieval_eval: run single round retrieval evaluation for hidden test split using last turn only
compute_retrieval_std_err: compute standard error for retrieval evaluation metrics R1, R5, R10, mean, and MRR
run_retrieval_cli: run retrieval evaluation CLI with JSON paths for ground truth candidates and model scores
